Salmon and tuna nigiri with cucumber and avocado maki on seasoned sushi rice, served with wasabi, pickled ginger and soy. Rinse 400g sushi rice until clear, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Slice 200g sashimi salmon and 200g sashimi tuna. Shape 16 small oblongs of rice, dab with wasabi and top with fish. Lay rice on 3 nori sheets, add cucumber and avocado strips, roll tight with a mat and cut each into 8. Serve with soy and pickled ginger.

Flathead in a light beer batter, fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and chipotle mayo. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold lager and a pinch of salt. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Dice 2 tomatoes, half a red onion and a handful of coriander with lime juice for pico de gallo. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with shredded cabbage, fish, pico and chipotle mayo.

Bourbon stirred over ice with brown sugar syrup and orange bitters, poured over one big cube with a flamed strip of orange peel. Make syrup by dissolving 2 tbsp brown sugar in 2 tbsp hot water. In a jug with ice, stir 240ml bourbon, 4 tsp of the syrup and 8 dashes orange bitters for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim with it and drop it in.

s.note: smoked salmon blini on silver trays
s.how: Warm 16 cocktail blini on a tray at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with 1 tsp crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon (about 150g in total), 1/2 tsp salmon roe and a small sprig of dill. Pass around on a tray straight away so the blini are still warm.

s.note: nuts and a cold drink in the back of the limo
s.how: Melt 30g butter with 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chopped rosemary, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper and 1/2 tsp salt. Toss through 150g cashews and 150g almonds, spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway. Cool for 5 minutes so they crisp, then serve warm in a glass bowl.

m.note: Al Powell lives on snack cakes, you don't have to
m.how: Rub a 1kg beef topside with 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tsp salt. Roast at 200C for about 35 minutes until 52C inside, then rest 15 minutes and shave thin. Stir 2 tbsp horseradish into 150ml sour cream. Split 8 soft rolls, spread with the horseradish cream and fill with beef, 60g rocket and 100g pickled onions, sliced.

w.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 3 eggs one at a time and 1 tsp vanilla extract, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 80ml milk. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 180C for 22 minutes, cool and cut into 12 fingers. For the cream, boil 150g caster sugar with 50ml water to 118C and pour into 2 egg whites whisking hard until thick and glossy. Split the fingers and pipe the cream inside.
